ModMetaData.name: KillingReward 嗜血恩赐
ModMetaData.author: RunningBugs
ModMetaData.description:
Kills by your own colonists against hostile factions fill a blood tithe. Each filled tithe earns a boon from the dark archotech: instantly complete a research, raise a pawn's skill by 3, receive a full stack of any item, or grant the whole colony (animals and mechs included) a Dark Blessing of life renewal — 3 days of regeneration that closes wounds and regrows missing limbs.
我方小人亲手击杀敌对派系单位可积累「血祭」进度。进度打满即可获得黑暗超凡智能的恩赐：立刻完成一项研究、小人技能 +3、领取一整格指定物品，或降下黑暗赐福——全体殖民地成员（含动物与机械体）获得 3 天生命回复，持续回血并再生缺失的肢体。
